summary: Expose static_root and a --serve CLI flag
description: The CLI can serve src/living_graph/static so fetch() works. Tests must not start a blocking HTTP server.
scope: Add static_root() in src/living_graph/cli.py returning the Path to src/living_graph/static
Parse --serve and --port with a helper parse_args(argv)
Do not call serve_forever from tests
acceptanceCriteria: static_root() is a directory containing index.html. parse_args(['--serve', '--port', '8765']) has serve True and port 8765.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not call serve_forever in tests.
Do not require --root/--output when --serve is present.
